## Five Key Takeaways

::: {.takeaway}
**1. Reason comes first.** If you cannot write it in one sentence, do not open R yet.
:::

::: {.takeaway}
**2. The workflow keeps you honest.** RREAAAPP gives every analysis the same
eight stages, so nothing gets skipped under pressure.
:::

::: {.takeaway}
**3. Explore is not optional.** Most analysis failures are visible in the data
before any model is fitted.
:::

::: {.takeaway}
**4. AI speeds up each stage; it does not replace your judgement.** Verify
everything it gives you.
:::

::: {.takeaway}
**5. Publishing is part of the analysis.** Code on GitHub makes the work
checkable; data are shared only when ethics approval allows.
:::
